questions.text: दो संख्याओं 3 और 5 के लिए, (HCF – LCM) का मान है :
questions.text_english: The value of (HCF – LCM) for the two numbers 3 and 5 is :

questions.text: किसी प्राकृत संख्या n के लिए, संख्या 2ⁿ कभी-भी समाप्त नहीं होती है अंक :
questions.text_english: The number 2ⁿ, where n is a natural number, cannot end with the digit :
questions.solution: 2ⁿ can end in 2, 4, 6, or 8. It can never end in 0 because that would require the prime factorisation of 2ⁿ to contain 5 as a factor, which it does not. Powers of 2 cycle through units digits 2, 4, 8, 6 and never produce 0.

questions.text: यदि समीकरण x + y = c – 1 का हल (0, 0) है, तो c का मान है :
questions.text_english: If (0, 0) is the solution of the equation x + y = c – 1, then the value of c is :
questions.solution: Substituting (0,0): 0 + 0 = c – 1 → 0 = c – 1 → c = 1.
questions.chapter: Pair of Linear Equations in Two Variables

questions.text: 'a' का वह मान, जिसके लिए ax² + 3x + 1 = 0 के वास्तविक और समान मूल हैं, है :
questions.text_english: The value of 'a' for which ax² + 3x + 1 = 0 has real and equal roots is :
questions.solution: For real and equal roots, discriminant = 0. b² – 4ac = 0 → (3)² – 4(a)(1) = 0 → 9 = 4a → a = 9/4.

questions.text: निम्नलिखित समीकरणों में से कौन-सा द्विघात समीकरण है ?
questions.text_english: Which of the following equations is a quadratic equation ?
questions.solution: (A) x² = x² + 2x + 1 simplifies to 2x + 1 = 0, linear. (B) x² + x – 2 = 2x + 1 → x² – x – 3 = 0, which is quadratic. (C) expands to a cubic. (D) involves √x, not a polynomial. Answer is B.

questions.text: मूल-बिन्दु से बिन्दु (2, 3) की दूरी है :
questions.text_english: The distance of the point (2, 3) from the origin is :

questions.text: बिन्दुओं (1, 3) और (1, – 3) को मिलाने वाले रेखाखंड का मध्य-बिन्दु स्थित है :
questions.text_english: The mid-point of the line segment joining points (1, 3) and (1, –3) lies :

options.B: दूसरे चतुर्थांश में / in the second quadrant

questions.solution: Mid-point = ((1+1)/2, (3+(–3))/2) = (1, 0). The point (1, 0) lies on the x-axis.

questions.text: दी गई आकृति में, यदि DE ∥ BC, AD = 1·5 cm, DB = 3 cm और EC = 2 cm है, तो AC की लम्बाई है :
questions.text_english: In the given figure, if DE ∥ BC, AD = 1·5 cm, DB = 3 cm and EC = 2 cm, the length of AC is :
questions.solution: By Basic Proportionality Theorem: AD/DB = AE/EC → 1.5/3 = AE/2 → AE = 1 cm. So AC = AE + EC = 1 + 2 = 3 cm.
questions.image_description: Triangle ABC with D on AB and E on AC such that DE is parallel to BC. AD = 1.5 cm, DB = 3 cm, EC = 2 cm.

questions.text: दो संकेंद्रित वृत्तों में, छोटे वृत्त की स्पर्श-रेखा बड़े वृत्त को काटती है :
questions.text_english: In two concentric circles, a tangent to the smaller circle will intersect the larger circle at :
questions.solution: A tangent to the smaller circle is a secant to the larger circle (since the smaller circle is inside the larger). A secant intersects the larger circle at exactly two points.

questions.text_english: The value of (2 tan 60°) / (1 – tan² 60°) is :
questions.solution: tan 60° = √3. Numerator: 2√3. Denominator: 1 – (√3)² = 1 – 3 = –2. Result: 2√3 / (–2) = –√3.

questions.text: (sin² A + cos² A) + (sec² A – tan² A) – (cot² A – cosec² A) का मान है :
questions.text_english: The value of (sin² A + cos² A) + (sec² A – tan² A) – (cot² A – cosec² A) is :
questions.solution: Using identities: sin²A + cos²A = 1; sec²A – tan²A = 1; cot²A – cosec²A = –1. So the expression = 1 + 1 – (–1) = 1 + 1 + 1 = 3.

questions.text: जब सूर्य का उन्नयन 30° से 60° में बदलता है तो एक मीनार की छाया की लम्बाई :
questions.text_english: The length of the shadow of a tower when the sun's altitude changes from 30° to 60° will :
questions.solution: Shadow length = height / tan(angle). As angle increases from 30° to 60°, tan increases, so shadow length decreases (becomes shorter).

questions.text: दी गई आकृति में, छायांकित भाग निरूपित करता है :
questions.text_english: In the given figure, the shaded region represents :
questions.solution: The shaded region in the figure is the region between a chord and the minor arc — this is the minor segment.
questions.image_description: A circle with centre O. The shaded region is the area below a chord near the bottom of the circle — the minor segment.
questions.topic: Segments and Sectors of a Circle

questions.text: त्रिज्या r वाले एक वृत्त के चतुर्थांश का परिमाप है :
questions.text_english: The perimeter of a quadrant of a circle of radius r is :
questions.solution: Perimeter of a quadrant = arc length + 2 radii = (1/4)(2πr) + 2r = πr/2 + 2r.

questions.text: एक शंकु और एक बेलन की आधार त्रिज्याएँ और आयतन समान हैं। (शंकु की ऊँचाई : बेलन की ऊँचाई) है :
questions.text_english: A cone and a cylinder have the same base radius and volume. The (height of cone : height of cylinder) is :
questions.solution: Volume of cone = (1/3)πr²h₁; Volume of cylinder = πr²h₂. Setting equal: (1/3)h₁ = h₂ → h₁/h₂ = 3/1 → 3 : 1.

questions.text: बहुलक के सूत्र बहुलक = l + [(f₁ – f₀) / (2f₁ – f₀ – f₂)] × h में f₁ दर्शाता है :
questions.text_english: In the formula of mode given by mode = l + [(f₁ – f₀) / (2f₁ – f₀ – f₂)] × h, f₁ denotes the :

options.A: बहुलक वर्ग की बारंबारता / frequency of the modal class
options.B: बहुलक वर्ग से ठीक पहले वाले वर्ग की बारंबारता / frequency of class preceding modal class
options.C: बहुलक वर्ग के ठीक बाद में आने वाले वर्ग की बारंबारता / frequency of class succeeding modal class
options.D: बहुलक वर्ग की संचयी बारंबारता / cumulative frequency of modal class

options_english.B: frequency of class preceding modal class
options_english.C: frequency of class succeeding modal class

questions.solution: In the mode formula, l is the lower limit of modal class, f₁ is the frequency of the modal class, f₀ is the frequency of the class preceding the modal class, f₂ is the frequency of the class succeeding the modal class, and h is the class size.

questions.text: किसी बंटन के लिए, यदि माध्य = माध्यक = a है, तो इस बंटन का बहुलक है :
questions.text_english: For a distribution, if mean = median = a, then its mode is :
questions.solution: Using the empirical relation: Mode = 3 × Median – 2 × Mean = 3a – 2a = a.
questions.topic: Relationship between Mean, Median and Mode

questions.text: तीन पासों को एक साथ फेंकने पर संभव परिणामों की कुल संख्या है :
questions.text_english: The total number of outcomes in the experiment of simultaneous throw of three dice is :
questions.solution: Each die has 6 outcomes. Three dice simultaneously: 6 × 6 × 6 = 216.

questions.text:
अभिकथन (A) : 36 को विभाजित करने वाली अभाज्य संख्याएँ 6 को भी विभाजित करती हैं।
तर्क (R) : कोई संख्या यदि p² को विभाजित करती है, तो वह p को भी विभाजित करती है।
questions.text_english:
Assertion (A) : The prime numbers which divide 36 also divide 6.
Reason (R) : Any number which divides p² also divides p.
questions.instruction_line: दो कथन दिए गए हैं, जिनमें एक को अभिकथन (A) तथा दूसरे को तर्क (R) द्वारा अंकित किया गया है। इन प्रश्नों के सही उत्तर नीचे दिए गए कोडों (A), (B), (C) और (D) में से चुनकर दीजिए।
questions.instruction_line_english: Two statements are given, one labelled as Assertion (A) and the other is labelled as Reason (R). Select the correct answer to these questions from the codes (A), (B), (C) and (D) as given below.

options.A: अभिकथन (A) और तर्क (R) दोनों सही हैं और तर्क (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या करता है।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) और तर्क (R) दोनों सही हैं, परन्तु तर्क (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सही है, परन्तु तर्क (R) गलत है।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) गलत है, परन्तु तर्क (R) सही है।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: Assertion (A): Prime factors of 36 = 2² × 3² are 2 and 3. 6 = 2 × 3, so 2 and 3 also divide 6. True. Reason (R): If a prime p divides p², it divides p (by Euclid's Lemma). This is true and correctly explains (A) because the prime factors of 36 = 6², i.e. p = 6, and primes dividing 6² also divide 6. Both true, R correctly explains A.

questions.text:
अभिकथन (A) : सभी सर्वांगसम त्रिभुज, समरूप त्रिभुज होते हैं।
तर्क (R) : सर्वांगसम त्रिभुजों में, संगत भुजाओं का अनुपात 1 : 1 होता है।
questions.text_english:
Assertion (A) : All congruent triangles are similar.
Reason (R) : In congruent triangles, the ratio of corresponding sides is 1 : 1.
questions.instruction_line: दो कथन दिए गए हैं, जिनमें एक को अभिकथन (A) तथा दूसरे को तर्क (R) द्वारा अंकित किया गया है। इन प्रश्नों के सही उत्तर नीचे दिए गए कोडों (A), (B), (C) और (D) में से चुनकर दीजिए।
questions.instruction_line_english: Two statements are given, one labelled as Assertion (A) and the other is labelled as Reason (R). Select the correct answer to these questions from the codes (A), (B), (C) and (D) as given below.

options.A: अभिकथन (A) और तर्क (R) दोनों सही हैं और तर्क (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या करता है।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) और तर्क (R) दोनों सही हैं, परन्तु तर्क (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सही है, परन्तु तर्क (R) गलत है।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) गलत है, परन्तु तर्क (R) सही है।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: Assertion (A): Congruent triangles have equal corresponding angles and proportional (equal, ratio 1:1) corresponding sides, so they are similar. True. Reason (R): In congruent triangles corresponding sides are equal, so their ratio is 1:1. True. R correctly explains A.

sub_questions.text:
c का वह मान ज्ञात कीजिए जिसके लिए निम्नलिखित रैखिक समीकरण युग्म के अपरिमित रूप से अनेक हल हैं :
cx + 3y = c – 3
12x + cy = c
sub_questions.text_english:
Find the value of c for which the following pair of linear equations has infinitely many solutions :
cx + 3y = c – 3
12x + cy = c
sub_questions.solution:
For infinitely many solutions: a₁/a₂ = b₁/b₂ = c₁/c₂
c/12 = 3/c = (c–3)/c
From c/12 = 3/c → c² = 36 → c = 6 (taking positive value).
Verification: 3/c = 3/6 = 1/2 and (c–3)/c = 3/6 = 1/2. ✓ So c = 6.

sub_questions.text:
x और y के लिए हल कीजिए :
3x + 2y = 65
2x + 3y = 60
sub_questions.text_english:
Solve for x and y :
3x + 2y = 65
2x + 3y = 60
sub_questions.solution:
Adding both equations: 5x + 5y = 125 → x + y = 25.
Subtracting second from first: x – y = 5.
Solving: x = 15, y = 10.

questions.chapter: Pair of Linear Equations in Two Variables

questions.text: त्रिभुज ABC की भुजा BC पर एक बिंदु D इस प्रकार स्थित है कि ∠ADC = ∠BAC. सिद्ध कीजिए कि (CA)² = CB . CD.
questions.text_english: D is a point on side BC of △ABC such that ∠ADC = ∠BAC. Prove that (CA)² = CB . CD.

key_points: So CB/CA = CA/CD → CA² = CB · CD

questions.solution:
In △BAC and △ADC:
∠BAC = ∠ADC (given)
∠BCA = ∠ACD (common angle ∠C)
By AA similarity criterion: △BAC ~ △ADC
Therefore: CB/CA = CA/CD (corresponding sides of similar triangles are proportional)
Hence (CA)² = CB × CD. (Proved)

questions.text: सिद्ध कीजिए कि वृत्त के किसी बिंदु पर खींची गई स्पर्श-रेखा, स्पर्श बिंदु से गुज़रने वाली त्रिज्या पर लंब होती है।
questions.text_english: Prove that the tangent drawn at any point of the circle is perpendicular to the radius through the point of contact.

key_points: Let O be centre, P be point of contact, XY be tangent
Take any point Q on tangent XY other than P; OQ > OP (since Q lies outside circle)
Therefore OP is the shortest distance from O to line XY, hence OP ⊥ XY

questions.solution:
Given: A circle with centre O. XY is a tangent to the circle at point P. OP is the radius.
To Prove: OP ⊥ XY.
Proof: Take any point Q on the tangent XY other than P. Since Q lies on the tangent and the tangent touches the circle only at P, Q lies outside the circle. Therefore OQ > OP (radius). This is true for every point Q on XY other than P. Hence OP is the shortest distance from O to line XY. Since the perpendicular is the shortest distance from a point to a line, OP ⊥ XY. (Proved)

questions.text: मान ज्ञात कीजिए : cos 45° / (sec 30° + cosec 30°)
questions.text_english: Evaluate : cos 45° / (sec 30° + cosec 30°)

sub_questions.text: एक बड़े वृत्त के त्रिज्यखंड, जिसका केंद्रीय कोण 120° है, का क्षेत्रफल एक छोटे वृत्त के क्षेत्रफल के बराबर है। छोटे वृत्त और बड़े वृत्त की त्रिज्याएँ क्रमशः 'r' और 'R' हैं। r : R ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: The area of a smaller circle is equal to the area of a sector of a larger circle with central angle 120°. The radii of the smaller and larger circles are 'r' and 'R' respectively. Find r : R.
sub_questions.solution:
Area of smaller circle = πr².
Area of sector = (120°/360°) × πR² = (1/3)πR².
Setting equal: πr² = (1/3)πR² → r² = R²/3 → r/R = 1/√3.
So r : R = 1 : √3.

sub_questions.text: दी गई आकृति में, त्रिज्या 7 cm के वृत्त का केन्द्र O है। AB, वृत्त की एक जीवा है। छायांकित भाग का परिमाप ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: In the given figure, O is the centre of a circle of radius 7 cm. AB is a chord of the circle. Find the perimeter of the shaded region.

key_points: Perimeter = arc AB + chord AB = (22/3 + 7) cm

sub_questions.solution:
From the figure, central angle AOB = 60°, radius = 7 cm.
Since OA = OB = 7 cm and ∠AOB = 60°, triangle OAB is equilateral, so AB = 7 cm.
Arc length AB = (60°/360°) × 2π × 7 = (1/6) × 2 × (22/7) × 7 = 22/3 cm.
Perimeter of shaded region (minor segment) = arc AB + chord AB = 22/3 + 7 = (22 + 21)/3 = 43/3 cm ≈ 14.33 cm.

questions.image_description: Circle with centre O and radius 7 cm. Chord AB subtends a central angle of 60° at O. The shaded region is the minor segment cut off by chord AB.
questions.topic: Area and Perimeter of Sectors and Segments

sub_questions.text: सिद्ध कीजिए कि √5 एक अपरिमेय संख्या है।
sub_questions.text_english: Prove that √5 is an irrational number.

key_points: Substituting leads to 5 dividing q as well
Contradiction with p and q being coprime

sub_questions.solution:
Assume √5 is rational. Then √5 = p/q where p, q are integers, q ≠ 0, and HCF(p,q) = 1.
Squaring: 5 = p²/q² → p² = 5q².
Since 5 divides p², by theorem (if prime p divides a², it divides a), 5 divides p.
Let p = 5m. Then (5m)² = 5q² → 25m² = 5q² → q² = 5m².
So 5 divides q² → 5 divides q.
But then 5 divides both p and q, contradicting HCF(p,q) = 1.
Hence our assumption is wrong and √5 is irrational. (Proved)

sub_questions.text: अंकगणित का आधारभूत प्रमेय लिखिए और इसके प्रयोग से, 36 और 54 का ल.स. (LCM) ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: State the 'Fundamental Theorem of Arithmetic' and use it to find LCM of 36 and 54.

key_points: Fundamental Theorem: Every composite number can be expressed as a product of primes in a unique way

sub_questions.solution:
Fundamental Theorem of Arithmetic: Every composite number can be expressed (factorised) as a product of primes, and this factorisation is unique, apart from the order in which the prime factors occur.
36 = 2² × 3²
54 = 2 × 3³
LCM = product of highest powers of all prime factors = 2² × 3³ = 4 × 27 = 108.

questions.topic: Irrational Numbers / Fundamental Theorem of Arithmetic

questions.text: बहुपद p(x) = 3x² – 2x – 1 के शून्यक ज्ञात कीजिए और p(x) के शून्यकों तथा p(x) के गुणांकों के बीच संबंध की सत्यता की जाँच कीजिए।
questions.text_english: Find the zeroes of the polynomial p(x) = 3x² – 2x – 1 and verify the relationship between the zeroes of p(x) and the coefficients of p(x).

key_points: Sum of zeroes = 2/3 = –(coefficient of x)/(coefficient of x²)
Product of zeroes = –1/3 = constant term / coefficient of x²

questions.solution:
3x² – 2x – 1 = 0
Factorising: 3x² – 3x + x – 1 = 3x(x – 1) + 1(x – 1) = (3x + 1)(x – 1) = 0
Zeroes: x = 1 and x = –1/3.

Verification:
Sum of zeroes = 1 + (–1/3) = 2/3 = –(–2)/3 = –b/a ✓
Product of zeroes = 1 × (–1/3) = –1/3 = c/a ✓
questions.topic: Zeroes of a Polynomial and their Relationship with Coefficients

sub_questions.text:
निम्नलिखित रैखिक समीकरण युग्म को ग्राफ द्वारा हल कीजिए :
2x – y = 2 और 4x – y = 4
इन समीकरणों से निरूपित रेखाएँ, y-अक्ष को जिन बिंदुओं पर प्रतिच्छेदित करती हैं, उन बिंदुओं के निर्देशांक भी लिखिए।
sub_questions.text_english:
Solve graphically the following pair of linear equations :
2x – y = 2 and 4x – y = 4
Also, write the coordinates of the points where the lines represented by these equations cut the y-axis.
sub_questions.solution:
For 2x – y = 2: When x=0, y=–2; when x=1, y=0; when x=2, y=2.
For 4x – y = 4: When x=0, y=–4; when x=1, y=0; when x=2, y=4.
Both lines pass through (1, 0), so the solution is x = 1, y = 0.
Line 1 cuts y-axis at (0, –2).
Line 2 cuts y-axis at (0, –4).

sub_questions.text: क्रिकेट कोचिंग प्रदान करने वाली एक अकादमी ने 10 बल्ले और 5 गेंदें, ₹ 32,500 में खरीदे। बाद में, अकादमी ने 2 बल्ले और 8 गेंदें, ₹ 10,000 में खरीदे। यदि बल्ले और गेंद की कीमत में कोई बदलाव नहीं हुआ हो, तो 1 बल्ले और 1 गेंद की कीमत ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: An academy offering cricket coaching bought 10 bats and 5 balls for ₹ 32,500. Later, the academy bought 2 bats and 8 balls for ₹ 10,000. If there is no change in the cost of the bat and of the ball, find the cost of 1 bat and 1 ball.

questions.text: दी गई आकृति में, TP और TQ, वृत्त के बिन्दुओं P और Q पर क्रमशः स्पर्श-रेखाएँ हैं। यदि प्रतिवर्ती ∠POQ = 250° है, तो चतुर्भुज POQT के प्रत्येक कोण की माप ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english: In the given figure, TP and TQ are tangents at points P and Q of the circle respectively. If reflex ∠POQ = 250°, find the measure of each angle of quadrilateral POQT.
questions.solution:
Reflex ∠POQ = 250°, so ∠POQ (non-reflex) = 360° – 250° = 110°.
Since TP and TQ are tangents, OP ⊥ TP and OQ ⊥ TQ (radius ⊥ tangent at point of contact).
So ∠OPT = 90° and ∠OQT = 90°.
Sum of angles of quadrilateral POQT = 360°.
∠PTQ = 360° – 90° – 90° – 110° = 70°.
Angles of quadrilateral POQT: ∠POQ = 110°, ∠OPT = 90°, ∠OQT = 90°, ∠PTQ = 70°.
questions.image_description: Circle with centre O. External point T. TP and TQ are tangents from T to the circle touching at P and Q respectively. Reflex angle POQ = 250°.

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित त्रिकोणमितीय सर्वसमिका को सिद्ध कीजिए :
cos θ / (1 + sin θ) + (1 + sin θ) / cos θ = 2 sec θ
questions.text_english:
Prove the following trigonometric identity :
cos θ / (1 + sin θ) + (1 + sin θ) / cos θ = 2 sec θ
questions.solution:
LHS = cos θ / (1 + sin θ) + (1 + sin θ) / cos θ
= [cos²θ + (1 + sin θ)²] / [cos θ(1 + sin θ)]
= [cos²θ + 1 + 2sin θ + sin²θ] / [cos θ(1 + sin θ)]
= [(cos²θ + sin²θ) + 1 + 2sin θ] / [cos θ(1 + sin θ)]
= [1 + 1 + 2sin θ] / [cos θ(1 + sin θ)]
= [2 + 2sin θ] / [cos θ(1 + sin θ)]
= 2(1 + sin θ) / [cos θ(1 + sin θ)]
= 2 / cos θ
= 2 sec θ = RHS. (Proved)

questions.text:
संयोग (chance) के एक खेल में, एक पहिये को घुमाया जाता है, जो विश्राम में आने के बाद संख्याओं 1, 2, 3, …, 10 (दी गई आकृति में दिखाए अनुसार) में से किसी एक संख्या को इंगित करता है। यदि सभी परिणाम समप्रायिक हैं, तो इसकी क्या प्रायिकता है कि यह पहिया :
(i) 2 से बड़ी अभाज्य संख्या को इंगित करेगा ?
(ii) 9 से छोटी विषम संख्या को इंगित करेगा ?
(iii) 4 के गुणज को इंगित करेगा ?
questions.text_english:
A game of chance consists of spinning a wheel which comes to rest at one of the numbers from 1 to 10 (as shown in the given figure) with equal probabilities. What is the probability that the wheel stops at
(i) a prime number greater than 2 ?
(ii) an odd number less than 9 ?
(iii) a multiple of 4 ?
questions.solution:
Total outcomes = 10.
(i) Prime numbers greater than 2 from 1–10: 3, 5, 7 → 3 favourable outcomes (wait: also check if problem means strictly > 2; primes > 2 are 3, 5, 7 → 3 numbers, but let me re-check: also prime number 2 itself is excluded; primes in 1-10 = 2,3,5,7; primes > 2: 3,5,7 → 3 outcomes). Wait — actually rechecking: from figure the numbers are 1–10, primes > 2 are 3, 5, 7 (3 numbers). But standard answer for this paper is 4/10 = 2/5. Let me reconsider: primes > 2 in 1–10 are 3, 5, 7 — that's only 3. Hmm, perhaps the paper considers also looking at it differently. Standard answer should be 3/10 for primes >2... Actually re-reading: P(prime > 2) = 3/10 is also possible. Let's keep: (i) Primes > 2: {3,5,7} — 3 numbers — P = 3/10.
(ii) Odd numbers less than 9: {1, 3, 5, 7} — 4 numbers — P = 4/10 = 2/5.
(iii) Multiples of 4: {4, 8} — 2 numbers — P = 2/10 = 1/5.
questions.image_description: A spinning wheel divided into 10 equal sectors numbered 1 to 10.

sub_questions.text: दो वर्गों के क्षेत्रफलों का योगफल 2650 cm² है। यदि उनके परिमापों का योगफल 280 cm है, तो दिए गए दो वर्गों की भुजाएँ ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: The sum of areas of two squares is 2650 cm². If the sum of their perimeters is 280 cm, find the sides of the two given squares.
sub_questions.solution:
Let the sides of the two squares be a and b.
a² + b² = 2650 ...(1)
4a + 4b = 280 → a + b = 70 ...(2)
From (2): b = 70 – a.
Substituting in (1): a² + (70 – a)² = 2650
a² + 4900 – 140a + a² = 2650
2a² – 140a + 4900 – 2650 = 0
2a² – 140a + 2250 = 0
a² – 70a + 1125 = 0
a² – 45a – 25a + 1125 = 0
a(a – 45) – 25(a – 45) = 0
(a – 45)(a – 25) = 0
a = 45 or a = 25.
If a = 45, b = 25 and vice versa.
The sides of the two squares are 45 cm and 25 cm.

questions.text: दो त्रिभुजों की समरूपता की कसौटी SAS को लिखिए। दी गई आकृति में, दिया गया है कि OA . OC = OB . OD. कसौटी SAS का प्रयोग करके, सिद्ध कीजिए कि AD ∥ CB.
questions.text_english: State the SAS criteria of similarity of two triangles. In the given figure, it is given that OA . OC = OB . OD. Use the SAS criteria to prove that AD ∥ CB.

key_points: SAS similarity: if one angle of a triangle is equal to one angle of the other and the sides including these angles are proportional
Therefore ∠OAD = ∠OBC (alternate interior angles), hence AD ∥ CB

questions.solution:
SAS Similarity Criterion: If one angle of a triangle is equal to one angle of the other triangle and the sides including these angles are proportional, then the two triangles are similar.

Given: OA · OC = OB · OD → OA/OB = OD/OC.

In △AOD and △BOC:
OA/OB = OD/OC (rearranging the given)
∠AOD = ∠BOC (vertically opposite angles)

By SAS similarity criterion: △AOD ~ △BOC.

Therefore ∠OAD = ∠OBC (corresponding angles of similar triangles).

Since ∠OAD and ∠OBC are alternate interior angles with transversal AB cutting lines AD and CB, AD ∥ CB. (Proved)
questions.image_description: Two triangles sharing vertex O. Points A and D on one side, points B and C on another side. Lines AD and CB appear to intersect at O.

questions.text: लकड़ी के एक ठोस बेलन के एक सिरे से इसी व्यास वाला एक अर्धगोला काट कर निकाल लिया जाता है, जैसा आकृति में दिखाया गया है। यदि बेलन की ऊँचाई 10 cm और व्यास 14 cm है, तो शेष बचे हुए लकड़ी के ठोस का कुल पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल ज्ञात कीजिए। (π = 22/7 प्रयोग कीजिए)
questions.text_english: A wooden article was made by scooping out a hemisphere (of same diameter) from one end of a solid cylinder as shown in the given figure. If the height of the cylinder is 10 cm and the diameter of the cylinder is 14 cm, find the total surface area of the remaining wooden article. (Use π = 22/7)
questions.solution:
Height of cylinder h = 10 cm, diameter = 14 cm, radius r = 7 cm.

Total Surface Area of remaining solid = Curved surface area of cylinder + Area of top circular base (not scooped) + Curved surface area of hemisphere.

Note: The bottom of the cylinder is intact (circle), one end has hemisphere scooped out (so no flat circle there, but the curved hemisphere surface is exposed).

CSA of cylinder = 2πrh = 2 × (22/7) × 7 × 10 = 440 cm²
Area of one circular base (top) = πr² = (22/7) × 49 = 154 cm²
CSA of hemisphere = 2πr² = 2 × (22/7) × 49 = 308 cm²

Total SA = 440 + 154 + 308 = 902 cm².

Note: The flat circular face at the bottom of the cylinder remains intact. The top face has a hemisphere scooped out — so the top flat annular ring is gone and replaced by the curved hemisphere surface. Actually for a hemisphere scooped from one end: the base of the cylinder (other end) = πr² remains. The top end has no flat face (hemisphere removed from it). The inside curved surface of hemisphere is exposed.

Total SA = CSA of cylinder + base circle area + curved surface of hemisphere
= 2πrh + πr² + 2πr²
= 2πrh + 3πr²
= (22/7)[2×7×10 + 3×49]
= (22/7)[140 + 147]
= (22/7) × 287
= 22 × 41
= 902 cm².
questions.image_description: A solid cylinder of height 10 cm and diameter 14 cm with a hemisphere of the same diameter scooped out from one end.

sub_questions.text:
एक पौधे की 40 पत्तियों की लम्बाइयाँ निकटतम मिलीमीटर में मापी जाती हैं तथा प्राप्त आँकड़ों को निम्नलिखित सारणी के रूप में निरूपित किया जाता है :

लम्बाई (mm में) | पत्तियों की संख्या
100 – 120       |       8
120 – 140       |       9
140 – 160       |      12
160 – 180       |       5
180 – 200       |       6

पत्तियों की माध्यक लम्बाई (mm में) ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english:
The lengths of 40 leaves of a plant are measured, correct to the nearest millimetre and data obtained is represented in the following table :

Length in (mm) | Number of leaves
100 – 120      |        8
120 – 140      |        9
140 – 160      |       12
160 – 180      |        5
180 – 200      |        6

Find the median length (in mm) of the leaves.
sub_questions.solution:
n = 40, n/2 = 20.
Cumulative frequencies:
100–120: cf = 8
120–140: cf = 17
140–160: cf = 29 ← median class (cf first exceeds 20)
160–180: cf = 34
180–200: cf = 40

Median class = 140–160.
l = 140, cf = 17 (preceding cumulative frequency), f = 12, h = 20.
Median = l + [(n/2 – cf)/f] × h = 140 + [(20 – 17)/12] × 20 = 140 + (3/12) × 20 = 140 + 5 = 145 mm.

questions.text: पतंग उत्सव भारत में एक लोकप्रिय त्योहार है जो मकर संक्रांति के दौरान मनाया जाता है। यह त्योहार लोगों द्वारा अपनी छतों से पतंग उड़ाकर मनाया जाता है। रीना और रवि भी त्योहार का आनंद लेने के लिए पतंग उड़ा रहे हैं। रीना की पतंग की ऊँचाई धरती से 60 m ऊपर है। पतंग से जुड़ी डोर अस्थायी रूप से धरती पर एक बिंदु से बँधी होती है, और धरती के साथ डोर का झुकाव 30° है। रवि 10 m ऊँची इमारत से पतंग उड़ा रहा है। उसकी पतंग भी धरती से 60 m ऊपर उड़ रही है और रवि द्वारा इस्तेमाल की गई डोर की लम्बाई रीना की डोर के समान है। θ, छत के एक बिन्दु से रवि की पतंग का उन्नयन कोण है।
questions.text_english: Kite festival is a popular festival in India which takes place during Makar Sankranti. The festival is celebrated by people flying kites from their rooftops. Reena and Ravi are also flying kites to enjoy the festival. The height of Reena's kite is 60 m above the ground. The string attached to the kite is temporarily tied to a point on the ground, and the inclination of the string with the ground is 30°. Ravi is flying a kite from a 10 m high building. His kite is also flying 60 m above the ground and the length of the string used by Ravi is same as that of Reena's. θ is the angle of elevation of Ravi's kite from a point on the rooftop.

sub_questions.text: रीना द्वारा इस्तेमाल करने वाली डोर की लम्बाई ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Find the length of string used by Reena.
sub_questions.solution: sin 30° = height / string length → 1/2 = 60 / L → L = 120 m.

sub_questions.text: sin θ का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Find the value of sin θ.
sub_questions.solution:
Ravi flies from 10 m building; kite is at 60 m. Vertical height of kite above rooftop = 60 – 10 = 50 m. String length = 120 m (same as Reena's). sin θ = 50/120 = 5/12.

Alternatively, some solutions treat: height above ground = 60 m, observer at 10 m building rooftop, string = 120 m. sin θ = (60–10)/120 = 50/120 = 5/12.

sub_questions.text: यदि डोर की लम्बाई में किसी परिवर्तन के बिना, θ को 60° में बदला जाता है, तो धरती से रवि की पतंग की ऊँचाई क्या होगी ? (√3 = 1·7 प्रयोग कीजिए)
sub_questions.text_english: If θ changes to 60°, without changing the length of the string, what will be the height of Ravi's kite above the ground ? (Use √3 = 1·7)
sub_questions.solution:
String from rooftop = 120 m, angle = 60°.
Height above rooftop = 120 × sin 60° = 120 × (√3/2) = 60√3 m.
Height above ground = 10 + 60√3 = 10 + 60 × 1.7 = 10 + 102 = 112 m.

sub_questions.text: यदि डोरी का झुकाव धरती के साथ 30° है, तो रवि की पतंग की धरती से ऊँचाई कितनी होगी, यह मानते हुए कि डोरी की लम्बाई नहीं बदलती है ?
sub_questions.text_english: What would have been the height of Ravi's kite above the ground, if the string had an inclination of 30° with the ground, assuming that the length of the string does not change ?
sub_questions.solution:
String from rooftop = 120 m, inclination with ground = 30°.
Vertical height above rooftop = 120 × sin 30° = 120 × 1/2 = 60 m.
Height above ground = 10 + 60 = 70 m.

questions.image_description: Illustration of Reena flying a kite 60 m above ground from ground level with string inclined at 30°. Ravi flying kite from a 10 m building rooftop with kite also 60 m above ground.

questions.text: एक महिला ने अपनी दोस्त से ₹ 10,00,000 उधार लिए और अगले महीने से मासिक किस्तों में उधार लिया हुआ पैसा वापस करने का वादा किया। एक महीने पश्चात, उसने ₹ 10,000 वापस किए, अगले महीने उसने ₹ 15,000 वापस किए, तीसरे महीने में उसने ₹ 20,000 वापस किए और इसी तरह प्रत्येक महीने की किस्त में समान रूप से वृद्धि करते हुए वापस करती रही।

After one month, she returned ₹ 10,000, the next month she returned ₹ 15,000, the third month she returned ₹ 20,000 and so on, thereby increasing the monthly instalment uniformly.

questions.text: एक मैदान आयताकार है। इस आयताकार मैदान ABCD के चारों कोनों के निर्देशांक A(10, 10), B(40, 10), C(40, 50) और D(x, y) हैं। दो दोस्त अनिल और अनिता ने एक दौड़ लगाने का फैसला किया। अनिता ने बिंदु A से दौड़ना शुरू किया और वह बिंदु E की ओर, विकर्ण AC की दिशा में, चल पड़ी, जहाँ E, ABCD के दोनों विकर्णों का प्रतिच्छेद बिंदु है। बिंदु E पर पहुँचकर, वह बिंदु B की ओर, विकर्ण DB की दिशा में जाती है और बिंदु B पर पहुँचने पर वह BA की दिशा में जाकर बिंदु A पर वापस आती है। अनिल बिंदु C से आरम्भ करके, D से होते हुए बिंदु A तक दौड़ लगाता है।
questions.text_english: A field is in the form of a rectangle. The coordinates of the rectangular field ABCD are A(10, 10), B(40, 10), C(40, 50) and D(x, y). Anil and Anita, two friends decided to have a race. Anita started from point A and moved to point E along the diagonal AC, where E is the point of intersection of both the diagonals of ABCD. From point E, she moved to point B along the other diagonal DB and then moved back to point A along BA. While Anil started from point C and ran to point A via D along the boundary of the field.

sub_questions.text: बिंदु E के निर्देशांक ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Find the coordinates of point E.
sub_questions.solution:
E is the intersection of diagonals of rectangle ABCD, i.e., the midpoint of AC (or BD).
D is found: Since ABCD is a rectangle, D = (10, 50).
Midpoint of AC = ((10+40)/2, (10+50)/2) = (25, 30).
So E = (25, 30).

sub_questions.text: बिंदुओं B और C के बीच की दूरी ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Find the distance between the points B and C.

sub_questions.text: बिंदु D के निर्देशांक और दूरी BD ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Find the coordinates of point D and the distance BD.
sub_questions.solution:
In rectangle ABCD with A(10,10), B(40,10), C(40,50):
D must be at (10, 50) (to complete the rectangle — same x as A, same y as C).
BD = distance from B(40,10) to D(10,50) = √[(40–10)² + (10–50)²] = √[900 + 1600] = √2500 = 50 units.

sub_questions.text: अनिता द्वारा तय की गई कुल दूरी ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Find the total distance travelled by Anita.

key_points: Total distance = AE + EB + BA = AC/2 + BD/2 + AB = 25 + 25 + 30 = 80 units

sub_questions.solution:
Anita travels: A → E → B → A.
AC = √[(40–10)² + (50–10)²] = √[900 + 1600] = √2500 = 50 units.
AE = AC/2 = 25 units.
BD = 50 units (from above). EB = BD/2 = 25 units.
AB = distance from A(10,10) to B(40,10) = 30 units.
